versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Cuckoo hens lay eggs in enemy units; a shared fight clock strikes every 3 attacks, hatching chicks that hit their hosts.
Grow either the clock (more strikes, Chime effects) or the brood (bigger, more chicks), joined by Ottilie at Tier 6.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rules gaps closed: Gernegroß keeps his slot and hatches first, foster Chicks land by their host, the Seven-Sleeper's long Doze is spelled out.
The Bellows now plainly doubles the Herald's once-a-fight buff, and Wechselbalg's copies have a set order and don't stack always-on effects.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rules holes closed: the clock strikes only after normal attacks, so Chime attacks can't chain strikes, and Ottilie's repeats come after Chime effects.
Kasimir's gold is capped at 2 a turn, several Bellows add one extra trigger each, and Wechselbalg hatches your own hosts first.
